chunks: Is it not a lie invented by them when they say:
ai.seo_question: What is the specific lie attributed to the disbelievers in this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse critiques the polytheists of Mecca who attributed daughters to Allah, exposing their claim as a baseless fabrication (ifk) rooted in their own desires rather than divine revelation. Shia exegetes emphasize that this 'lie' represents a fundamental distortion of Tawhid, where human projection replaces pure monotheistic truth, a theme resonating with the later Quranic declaration in Surah Ikhlas that He begets not.
